bullets.text: Fuel Crisis Threatens Telecoms - **Bangladesh** telcos warn of imminent service shutdowns due to severe fuel shortages.
Satellite Setback for AST - **AST SpaceMobile**'s BlueBird 7 satellite deployed in the wrong orbit, hindering D2D services.
SFR Offer Boosted - A **French telco consortium** raises bid for **SFR** to €20.4 billion, aiming for asset acquisition.
Merger Talks for Deutsche Telekom - **Deutsche Telekom** considers merging with **T-Mobile US**, potentially creating a telecom giant.
5G Performance Enhanced - **SoftBank** and **Ericsson** collaborate to improve 5G performance with uplink switching technology.
Arelion Expands Infrastructure - **Arelion** upgrades Nørre Nebel site to support more subsea cables and network scalability.
